eligibilityRules.rule: Each external capability contract is independently published and immutably identified outside the Core allocation
Passport/manifest authority supplies the maximum eligible capability key, exact version, immutable contract reference, and assigned ceiling or restrictions
Discovery advertises only the currently deployed subset
Offer and Grant narrow only to transaction-specific subsets or restrictions
Host metadata distinguishes required capabilities from optional interests and preferences
Consent supplies an immutable permitted subset
Policy may deny or narrow only
Capability key, capability version, and contract reference agree exactly
Conflicting key/version/contract mappings are rejected; namespace similarity, latest-version lookup, aliases, and defaults cannot resolve them
A namespace prevents collisions only and grants no identity, ownership, authenticity, Trust, publication, compatibility, or execution authority
Historical Connections resolve the exact immutable contract evidence committed at establishment
Mutable current, latest, package, SDK, network, or deployment lookup cannot replace or rewrite historical capability meaning
An isolated optional capability conflict may exclude only that exact key/version and only when every REQ-VERS-0013 condition permits it; shared-security or Host-required conflicts fail the candidate
